notes.random: It is compared with 200 random-entry runs at its own time in market: random intraday trades, never overlapping and closed by the session's last bar, with lengths drawn from that strategy's own trades and the same share of longs, paying the same costs.
notes.val: Not a clean test. This strategy was picked from the nb_nq_v2 finalists using their 2023–2024 results (Sharpe, beats-luck, both years profitable) as well as 2018–2022, so 2023–2024 is in-sample for the choice. It shows the strategy held up; it can't prove it. The untouched test is the 2025+ holdout tab.
notes.holdout: First noise-band look at the NQ holdout. No noise-band strategy had been scored on NQ 2025 onward before this run, and only this one, frozen beforehand, was run, so there's no selection among holdout results. The mean-reversion family was scored on NQ 2025+ earlier (a different strategy), so the researcher has seen how that period treated mean reversion. The ES noise-band pair's holdout result (2025+, a loss) was known when this was picked.

legs.settings_text: 15m bars, band lookback 1 day × 1, check every 15 min, first entry 60 min after the open, gap-adjusted anchor, VWAP exit, long + short, no entry cap, only when the last 30 min moved the same way, no stop
